findings.finding: acquire_run_lock is stubbed in tests, so the real SQL, the DATABASE_URL guard and normalize_database_url have no automated coverage (deferred to step-3 per plan).

Lock held on an idle dedicated connection for the whole run; an idle timeout or network drop would silently release the session lock mid-run, allowing a second run to double-ingest. No keepalive or check.
Probe runs with capture_output and is printed only after exit, not streamed; a hung probe logs nothing and has no timeout.
When the subprocess raises (e.g. OSError), the log line reads exit=None plus an extra error: line, a slight format deviation from the plan.
Held-lock path exits 0 without touching cron-failed state; no scope creep; both steps otherwise meet success criteria.
